notes.title: 🛠️ Project Update – July 2025
notes.content: [h3]✅ What’s already done:[/h3][list][*][p]🧱 [b]Level design and mapping are finished[/b]: every corner of the abandoned hospital is now in place, ready to be explored (or escaped).[/p][/*][*][p]🎬 [b]The official teaser is complete and published[/b]: you can now get a glimpse of the atmosphere, the tension, and what awaits in the shadows…[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧪 What we’re working on now:[/h3][list][*][p]🧩 [b]The playable demo[/b]: a solo version is in development. You’ll be able to explore the hospital, searching for a mysterious key… but don’t expect to escape so easily.[/p][/*][*][p]🎧 [b]Sound reaction system[/b]: the creature doesn’t like noise. We’re working on a feature where it reacts to your footsteps, dropped items, or heavy breathing…[/p][/*][*][p]🎥 [b]Facial recognition[/b]: yes, really. In the full version, the game may react to your expressions. Fear, tension, micro-reactions… it’s all being watched.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔜 What’s next?[/h3][p]We’re focusing on making a stable, immersive and frightening demo. Stay tuned, follow the page, and most importantly…[/p][p][b]Don’t make a sound. He’s listening.[/b][/p][p]— The development team 🖤[/p]
